import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

@torch.compile
def optimized_trimul(x: torch.Tensor, mask: torch.Tensor, p: dict) -> torch.Tensor:
    # Input norm in fp32
    xn = F.layer_norm(x, (x.shape[-1],), p["norm_in_w"], p["norm_in_b"])
    xn_bf16 = xn.to(torch.bfloat16)
    mask_bf16 = mask.to(torch.bfloat16)

    # Fused left projection + gate (2*H outputs)
    left_comb_w = torch.cat([p["left_w"], p["left_gate_w"]], dim=0).to(torch.bfloat16)
    left_comb_b = torch.cat([p["left_b"], p["left_gate_b"]], dim=0).to(torch.bfloat16)
    left_comb = F.linear(xn_bf16, left_comb_w, left_comb_b)  # (B, N, N, 2H)
    a_lin, a_gate = left_comb.chunk(2, dim=-1)
    a = a_lin * torch.sigmoid(a_gate) * mask_bf16

    # Fused right projection + gate (2*H outputs)
    right_comb_w = torch.cat([p["right_w"], p["right_gate_w"]], dim=0).to(torch.bfloat16)
    right_comb_b = torch.cat([p["right_b"], p["right_gate_b"]], dim=0).to(torch.bfloat16)
    right_comb = F.linear(xn_bf16, right_comb_w, right_comb_b)  # (B, N, N, 2H)
    b_lin, b_gate = right_comb.chunk(2, dim=-1)
    b = b_lin * torch.sigmoid(b_gate) * mask_bf16

    # Triangle multiplication via batched matmul
    B, N, _, D = a.shape
    a_reshaped = a.permute(0, 3, 1, 2).reshape(B * D, N, N)
    b_reshaped = b.permute(0, 3, 1, 2).reshape(B * D, N, N)
    o = torch.bmm(a_reshaped, b_reshaped.transpose(1, 2))
    o = o.view(B, D, N, N).permute(0, 2, 3, 1)  # back to (B, N, N, D)

    # Output norm in fp32 for accuracy
    o_fp32 = o.float()
    o_norm = F.layer_norm(o_fp32, (o_fp32.shape[-1],), p["norm_out_w"], p["norm_out_b"])

    # Output gate computed from xn (bf16), upcast for final multiply
    out_gate = torch.sigmoid(
        F.linear(xn_bf16, p["out_gate_w"].to(torch.bfloat16), p["out_gate_b"].to(torch.bfloat16))
    ).to(torch.float32)

    # Output projection in fp32
    out = F.linear(o_norm, p["out_w"], p["out_b"]) * out_gate
    return out
